derivations.method: Off Duty 21:00 carries no date; block 9h00 from STD 18:30 MAD puts arrival at 20:30 ORD still on 01/09, so Off Duty is 01/09 local at ORD = 2026-09-02T02:00Z

Report 20:20 has no station; header says times are local to the station shown, and the sector departs ORD, so it is Chicago local on 03/09 = 2026-09-04T01:20Z. Report is printed, not offset-derived; only the timezone was inferred
STA 13:50 and Off Duty 14:20 are undated; 9h00 block from 21:50 ORD lands 04/09 in MAD, so Off Duty = 04/09 14:20 MAD = 2026-09-04T12:20Z (duty 11h00 matches the printed Duty column)
Report 21:40 taken as JFK local on 07/09 (departure station) = 2026-09-08T01:40Z; printed Duty 10h00 to Off Duty confirms
Departure 23:10 JFK on 07/09 plus 8h00 block arrives MAD 13:10 on 08/09; Off Duty 13:40 MAD on 08/09 = 2026-09-08T11:40Z

Sectors 3 and 4 roll past midnight (MAD 23:55 to FCO 02:20, then FCO 03:23 to MAD 05:48 on 12/09); Off Duty 06:18 MAD on 12/09 = 2026-09-12T04:18Z, and report-to-off-duty then equals the printed 14h53
Off Duty 00:14 is earlier than the last STA 23:44, so it belongs to the following local day: 25/09 00:14 MAD = 2026-09-24T22:14Z; printed Duty 11h54 confirms
STA 08:10 SIN with 13h30 block from MAD 12:40 falls on 27/09; Off Duty 08:40 SIN on 27/09 = 2026-09-27T00:40Z, matching the printed 15h30 duty
Report 11:10 taken as SIN local (the departure station on the return leg), = 2026-09-28T03:10Z; printed Duty 15h30 to Off Duty 20:40 MAD confirms
